title: Tseung Kwan O Line A-Train
description: Resource pack that adds a fictional A-Train variant for the Tseung Kwan O Line.
body: It's 2008, and the Tseung Kwan O line has a shortage of K-Trains, due to them being moved to the Kwun Tong Line. So the MTR moves a few A-Trains from the Tung Chung line, refitting them for service on the Tseung Kwan O line, including redesigning their liveries, and replacing their route maps. This is where this resource pack comes in. This includes a fictional Tseung Kwan O line variant of the A-Train. This is for people who want extra trains in their worlds. Thank you for using this!
